about: G4's held-out rig, run 2 (PLAN.md §9.3): chosen on 2026-10-14 by a fresh subagent for the commit under test, adf77ee, from a source that neither WP-4.2's list (Quaternius, KayKit), G4 run 1 (orange juice games, re-uploaded by BoQsc) nor the library's motion sources (Mesh2Motion, CMU, 100STYLE, Quaternius) used. Its author's own repository carries the file and its CC0 statement (D57). Fetched by SHA-256 into .cache/fixtures/ and never committed (npm run fixtures -- fetch --manifest bench/results/heldout/G4/run-2/rig.json). Its license file is read at fetch time and must say CC0.

The avatar is licensed under CC0.' (the code is MIT; another avatar in the same notes, brunette.glb, is CC BY-NC and not used)
rigs.rig: Mixamo names without the mixamorig: prefix (Hips, Spine to Spine2, Neck, Head, LeftShoulder, LeftArm, LeftForeArm, LeftHand, LeftUpLeg, LeftLeg, LeftFoot, LeftToeBase), plus LeftButtock, LeftBreast, Jaw, eye and eyelid bones, a four-bone ponytail and 15 finger bones a hand: 67 bones, one skin. A realistic young woman in a casual suit, 1.77 m, in metres, A-pose, facing +Z, soles at y 0 and hips 0.97 m up. 8 skinned meshes (body, suit, eyes, eyebrows, eyelashes, ponytail, teeth, tongue), 155 morph targets, 7 embedded PNG textures, no clips, 36.8 MB
